maxconn.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections ipband can handle.

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to monitor for bandwidth.

pidfile.description: Full path to the PID file used by the ipband daemon.

logfile.description: Full path to the log file. Leave empty to disable file logging (syslog only).

statsfile.description: Path to the file where bandwidth statistics are written.

statsinterval.description: Interval (in seconds) between writes to the stats file.

daemonize.description: Run ipband as a background daemon process.

user.description: System user to run ipband as after startup.

grp.description: System group to run ipband as after startup.

bandwidth.description: Global and per-rule bandwidth control settings.

upload_limit.description: Global upload limit in KBytes/sec (0 = unlimited).

download_limit.description: Global download limit in KBytes/sec (0 = unlimited).

rules.description: List of custom bandwidth rules (e.g., per host, port, or protocol).

upload_limit.description: Upload limit in KBytes/sec (0 = inherit global).

download_limit.description: Download limit in KBytes/sec (0 = inherit global).

match_value.description: Value to match against (e.g., IP, port number, or protocol name).
